rules.rule: One polymorphic entry per rail, discriminating on input shape. Parallel entry points, modality-named siblings, get/getMany/getById families, and direction-named twins of one correspondence are defects; demand absorption into the one owner, never a new sibling. Judge every touched module's public roster as a designed artifact: arity twins, mode flags, and exports grown per capability are the same defect at folder tier; a helper with exactly one caller, no plausible second consumer, and no meaning in isolation inlines into that caller, and a consumer forced to sequence a module's internals marks the weak boundary the entrypoint absorbs.

Judge every surface from its consumers: a parameter a policy value or input shape reconstructs is knob spam; configuration ceremony pushed onto callers, or orchestration a consumer must hand-write, is a defect. Demand internalized lifecycle, routing, and policy with zero capability sacrifice. Parameterization hunts in both directions: a literal that encodes a decision or recurs across sites becomes a policy value or vocabulary row, a stringly key, path, or per-site spelling of one correspondence derives from the owning symbol, and inversely a knob set whose combinations the body re-derives collapses into policy rows, table dispatch, or a denser polymorphic owner with defaults derived once.

Hunt imperative and shape collapse: folds, combinators, tables, generators, generated owners, and discriminated types replace hand-rolled loops, branch ladders, parallel models, and types differing by one axis. Report a collapse only after proving one existing owner consumes the same state and rail while preserving every behavior, policy, precedence, lifetime, evidence field, and consumer contract. Equal row shape, labels, formulas, codecs, or current mappings do not establish one semantic owner; required ABI spellings remain on both sides, and a replacement spanning untouched ownership or lifetime concerns exceeds the changed defect. Every collapse demand states what the merge loses: where the plural form carries a guarantee — a per-folder closed roster's compile-time break, a dependency boundary keeping host SDKs above their stratum, a deliberate isolation co-location — the plurality is lawful, erasing the guarantee is a downgrade wearing density, and the unifying discriminant states at a durable owner so the twin surfaces never re-litigate. Two paradigms splitting one seam — an imperative or exception path beside the concern's monadic rail — are the same collapse target: one rail owns the concern end to end. Three shapes carry the collapse into dispatch: a total dispatch whose every arm returns a constant re-allocates that constant per call and collapses onto a generated map over precomputed static rows, arms answering alike sharing one row; a fold special-casing an operand by its immediate tag mis-recognizes the subtree wherever the tested property is inherited by composition, so recognition runs structurally over the whole subtree; and a dispatch ladder whose earlier arm's pattern forces a lazy operand pays an unreachable engine's cost, so cheap total gates precede every class pattern that reifies. Cite the canonical replacement and smallest replaced range.

Composition leverage is one hunt over two owner kinds — the admitted package and the lower stratum — and every finding names the owner, the uncomposed or duplicated member, and the smallest replacing range. Run the stacking census on every touched page, the diff and the touched file around it, against the folder and language .api tiers plus the central manifest, then demand the deepest verified operator on the existing owner: proven leverage includes Try.lift(...).Run() for provider exception custody; TensorPrimitives fused arithmetic, finite-span predicates, and reductions; QuikGraph roots, paths, acyclicity, components, and sinks; ArrayPoolBufferWriter<byte> for framed canonical emission; NodaTime interval, clock, and mapping operations; quantity algebra; endpoint-inclusive lattices; provider-native segment geometry; and a broker client's batch-grain delivery family — batch fold, per-record retry, manual offset resolution, commit precedence — over a flat per-message callback. A transport or overlay package re-exporting its core dependency's types makes the re-exported spelling the one import, a duplicate core import beside it the defect. Resolve the owning ARCHITECTURE strata table and seam ledger before judging any composition: the strata row names the owners a folder composes and capability a designated lower-stratum owner exports composes through its declared seam rather than re-rolling, so a fence re-deriving that capability — reconstructing endpoint, rotation, or signed-sweep evidence from raw coordinates where the owner's intrinsic case members export it — demands composition of that owner; an owner minted at a higher stratum for a concern a lower-stratum owner already carries is duplication the lower owner absorbs; and two sibling consumers composing one stratum owner through divergent spellings converge on one composed form. A shared mechanism homes at the LOWEST stratum every consumer references — homing it higher manufactures per-folder twins, a type or vocabulary re-declaring a lower-stratum owner's concept under a folder-local name is that twin whose fix composes the substrate owner as an instance, per-folder fact unions typing a shared mechanism are the one legitimate per-folder plurality, and a layout, grammar, or vocabulary two owners keep identical by hand with no sync guard is the same twin one typed owner dissolves. The homing split is dependency cleanliness: a piece stays high only while it needs a dependency the lower stratum cannot carry, and a consumer blocked on an unlanded higher-stratum surface stays blocked, since seating the awaited composition below its stratum to clear the block is the rejected shortcut. Confirmation bar for either owner kind: a shallow form is a defect only when the exact invocation, return shape, complete roster, owner input contract, and preserved semantics are confirmed, and a fragment or operator lacking deterministic walk, geometry, precedence, acceptance, fallback, or custody is not approved leverage. Extend the canonical owner by row, case, or member; an unconsumed verified member the touched owner's concern admits is a gap; and an overlapping second package enters only as a bounded fast-path under a named split predicate deciding which surface serves a call — a per-page arbitrary choice between two overlapping surfaces is the defect, and a fast-path member never owns the concern it accelerates.

Declared capability is consumed capability: a capability noun with no anchoring fence member, a receipt nothing mints, or a policy row nothing consumes is decorative density demanding the consuming member or the deletion; a policy column consumed only by a cache key, receipt, or log annotates rather than governs — demand the governing arm; an arm that cannot honor a policy field refuses the combination loudly before provider work — silent weakening is the defect. A row column declaring a capability carries the body that capability needs and the fold reads the column, so declaration and install cannot disagree and a second row costs one column answer rather than an edit at the consumer — a boolean column standing where a body belongs is the same decorative density one rank up.

Presume tenfold demand on every touched owner: name missing attributes, sub-kinds, states, relationships, invariants, or operations as rows, cases, or members inside that owner. Pressure the policy axes repeated fixes expose — bounds and integrality, allocation capacity, calendar gap/overlap resolution, numerical scaling, posture hysteresis with distinct validated entry and exit thresholds, identity framing, and case-owned projection data — but prove each from the owner charter or domain contract; zero current consumers never lowers the bar, and a vague could-be-richer note with no grounded axis is not a finding.
Domain logic — in design-page code fences and tooling source alike — rides typed result/effect rails. Raw exceptions in domain flow, or dual error paradigms crossing one boundary, are defects.

No compat shims, [Obsolete] aliases, backwards-compat wrappers, or migration helpers. Aggressive API breaking with every call site updated in the same change is the sanctioned path. The demand side answers the same law: a demanded migration, invalidation, or compatibility surface for a changed key, schema, or identity encoding is void on a corpus with no legacy consumer — the demand invents the forbidden surface.

Stateful stores rebuild from declared truth on shape change. Schema is ONE generation identified by a content digest over its artifact set; the deploy plane materializes that generation whole into a fresh namespace and cuts over atomically in one schema-rename transaction, while runtime verifies the generation it observes and never mutates it. Every relation declares its rebuild posture before it ships: Derived rebuilt from truth, Carried lifted by a declared INSERT ... SELECT inside the cutover transaction, Resident generation-invariant. Every migration script, Up/Down body, diff planner, expand-shadow-backfill-contract wave, and in-place alter is the forbidden surface; demand the generation replacement beside the relation's missing posture.

Code fences in planning design pages are the work product: transcription-complete declarations verified against the folder's .api/ catalogue. Abstract sketches, pseudo-code fences, hand-waved contracts, and phantom members are defects. Prose describing a fence binds to the fence's actual behavior: a signature row or behavior claim diverging from the body — a described transformation the code does not perform — is a wrong contract, and the correct form states the invariant the code embodies. A research row is recorded epistemic debt: a fence settling a member a sibling research row still declares unverified is a defect, and a resolved row deletes whole with no tombstone. An admitted central-manifest row carrying a sanctioned gate comment and named follow-up is design-real: verification is the manifest admission, never wheel availability, and demanding a page drop the package over a temporary distribution gap is the capability-gating defect.

Each language holds one canonical static gate and the central manifest is the truth source for which toolchain exists: a second compiler or checker lane beside the canonical gate, a manifest script running a stale or dev toolchain build beside the stable release, one gate lane reading the root project config while sibling scripts check per-project configs, and doctrine citing a checker or compiler no central manifest installs are split-brain gate defects — the demanded fix is the one canonical invocation everywhere, never a parallel lane.

Admission provenance decides every value-check claim before severity, and the demanded fix lands at root-cause depth: interior re-validation of an admitted value is deleted-form residue whose finding cites an admission-bypassing constructor or foreign seam before reopening the admitted owner, while a host crossing re-admits foreign values, since nulls and malformed shapes are real there — the admitted-shape carves themselves live in the rules.md do-not-flag charter. The defect-class roster is never restated here: resolve .macroscope/correctness/general/defect-classes.md live and derive every standing-class, identity, admission-mechanics, and fold-hygiene hunt from its current rows, demanding the form its end-state-depth law names — the shared family owner, the one root admission fold, the family fix over the sibling patch — never the literal local check. Findings cite the owner, the actual bypass or foreign seam, the canonical replacement, and the smallest range.

Use-time evidence moves to construction and one authority owns every derived value. The evidence-binding roster is never restated here: resolve .macroscope/correctness/general/defect-classes.md live and derive every construction-evidence, identity-and-key, content-preimage, receipt-timing, and delivery-verdict hunt from its current rows. A settlement or causal-log dedup keys on operation identity, never a content digest; an owner minted once per process takes only values whose lifetime matches its own — a per-request or ambient coordinate injected at a composition-root singleton pins one partition onto every later request, so the per-call coordinate resolves inside the call it describes; and a cooperative cancellation folded onto a domain fault reports a cancelled unit as a failed landing, so cancellation stays a rail fact and propagates. The Tier-0 transcription sets the cross-language-transcription-drift rule names are exempt from every derive-from-the-roster demand — their duty is the same-change repair at every transcribing anchor, never an import of a peer's spelling. Findings cite the evidence owner, the divergent or hand-maintained site, the canonical derivation, and the smallest range.

Host-mutation choreography carries proven end-states: a complete mutation plan derives against the un-mutated record so refusal leaves state untouched; one terminal admission bind over the construction switch keeps the admission authority single, and a scoped entry admits its request before acquiring the resource grant; pre-mutation total-state capture yields one compensation rail with restores landing in reverse order and restore faults appended to the primary, and a bracket owner composes suppression, body, restoration, and terminal flush on that one rail — never parallel failure paths; where clear-all is the host's only rollback member, the owner's journal turns batch failure into clear-and-replay, unclonable host state stages on the host-supplied copy — prove there, then commit — with the inverse misread the standing false positive: a duplicate-revise-then-commit flow mutates only a detached copy and publishes through the table's commit member, so the mutation target verifies as the live object before any live-mutation or partial-mutation flag — and raw multi-product host output converts to owned handles at the continuation head so rollback releases through handle custody; every host-event observer builds its fact and invokes its sink inside one catch frame so a consumer fault never escapes the dispatcher, every callback seam in a folder rides one shared guarded-invocation owner centralizing error-sink dispatch and secondary-failure combination with callback failures retained as per-lease evidence — never reduced to unobservable side effects — and a best-effort secondary projection folds its refusal into the committed receipt's optional-error slot, never failing the primary; an open/closed staging cell makes closure the empty state of the same atomic cell so producer/closer racing is structurally impossible — queue state and lifecycle state fold into one closed union cell inspected and replaced atomically, never separately synchronized cells or a read-then-clear pair where one atomic exchange owns the drain, and N lifecycle booleans beside one resource fold into that same closed owner — admission closing and in-flight work quiescing before terminal settlement, closure idempotent under repeated and concurrent invocation, settlement failures accumulated onto one rail, and a state-custody critical section encloses only the transition itself — callbacks, taps, provider construction, and flush I/O execute outside custody with competing writers retrying through a revision ticket or generation reservation, so a lock or semaphore held across a foreign callback demands the snapshot-compute-commit atomic swap, never a wider lock; a key-to-role map at a join seam is allow-list and completeness obligation at once, unmatched declared keys failing with the missing set as evidence; a payload field one backend consumes natively maps to an equivalent construction on every other backend, never silently dropped.

Lifecycle custody and completion evidence carry proven end-states worth demanding: registration claims an atomic slot with a unique token, invokes the host only for the winning claim, and on host failure removes only its own token; index and identity admission validates against live table counts with uniqueness and required-result rules in one family, sentinels explicitly admitted; a completion receipt proves expected coverage, uniqueness, validity, and host completion together — count equality alone is not proof; a host product minted mid-pipeline rides an owned lease through every downstream stage, disposed on every failure path including completed-prefix release.

Operator and workflow code is deterministic orchestration judged as production source: schema-typed agent outputs (every agent() call carries a label, model tier, effort, and a closed JSON schema), bounded loops, stage products written to disk with path receipts, per-run scratch paths minted deterministically from the target set so a resume rehydrates the same directory. Bare promises, unbounded polling, wall-clock branching, subagents instructed to wait, and hand-authored exit semantics beside a typed envelope contract are defects. Completed-with-failures and Fault ride distinct channels — a tool that ran and found defects stays Completed, and exit codes project from the one status owner, never re-derived per caller; host-exclusive work acquires the shared lease through the one combinator, never a hand-rolled lockfile; artifact writes route through the artifact store, and a tool write at repo root is a defect by name; a pass whose acceptance gate runs a network-bound toolchain stays native, never routed onto a codex wrapper. A promoted rule — a cs-analyzer RuleRow or a tools/biome GritQL row — describes the semantic shape of one anti-pattern (trigger, predicate, exemption) and ships with witnesses that must fire and compact code that must not; reviewer prose never restates what those gates enforce. A child process whose stdout feeds a parser launches with the runner's reporter silenced — pnpm exec rides pnpm --silent exec, since the reporter writes warnings to stdout ahead of child output; a decoder folding failure to a success-shaped empty over non-empty input launders corruption into a zero-results pass — legal only where the invocation record retains the raw stream as evidence, a fold discarding it landing the undecodable input as a typed defect row.

A test falsifies production behavior with an independent oracle, and every law family registers a refuting witness the law must fail on — a surviving witness is a tautology and the registration gap is the finding. Existence tests, mirror tests asserting a constructed value's own fields, specs proving only their own doubles were called, raw carrier-flag inspection where kit gates exist, failure-message substring dispatch, wall-clock sleeps in the unit lane, and vacuous greens over an absent producer or empty input set are defects. A spec-local helper, generator, or tolerance constant shadowing a _testkit owner extends the kit, never duplicates beside the spec, and every kit capability lands with its falsification twin proving it can fail. Graph under test is the production composition with edges re-provided — a substitute is a Layer against the same Tag with interior edges real, and a proof against a hand-assembled parallel graph proves only the parallel graph; process-boundary output decodes through NdjsonOracle, never stdout string-scraping.

Estate placement holds across the proof estate: tests/contracts/ custody reads each atomic case live from manifest.json and applies tests/contracts/README.md. A case contradicting its declared class, actors, readiness, proof, or asset custody is a finding; never copy the authority roster here. Container images pin only in tests/containers.json; markers are closed and auto-applied; benchmarks require their registry row; TypeScript unit specs colocate while C# and Python suites mirror production; e2e and load suffixes stay disjoint; every tools operator moves with its suite; reports land under .artifacts and work state under .cache through native configuration.

A folder is earned only by 2+ distinct non-eponymous children: a single-file folder flattens to the parent (graph.md, never graph/graph.md), a child echoing its parent folder's name — case-insensitive, singular or plural — renames to the distinct concept it owns, a folder names a larger domain concept that accretes siblings without rename, and grab-bag names (misc, utils, common, helpers, shared) are defects. Deep nesting is earned only when every intermediate level itself passes the floor.

Package custody and registry closure are one same-change fact. Versions live only in the central manifests, hand-edited, and a vendored SDK is a defect everywhere except the ruled vendor/ LFS natives — a new vendored binary demands its LFS attribute row and its owning RULINGS row in the same change, never a bare drop. Version movement is forward-only: a downgrade or stale floor without a recorded reason is a defect, a sanctioned pin carries an inline comment stating exactly what breaks without it — and the demand side answers the same law: a demanded new floor or pin justified by a hypothetical older release is void where the installed pinned-newest surface constructs the member, a pin earned only by a reproduced incompatibility — and a version family ruled to move as a matched set — sibling packages riding one upstream release wave, twin release tracks, a channel a composed member requires — moves together or not at all, so a single-member bump, a routine bump-to-newest against a ruled hold, and a unify-the-versions demand against ruled twin tracks are each the defect, the ruling riding the RULINGS registry or the pin comment. A central row with no direct manifest consumer carries a `Rides <puller>` maintenance comment naming its direct puller — an uncommented transitive row is illegible and re-flags on every census, and a row carrying the comment is proven indirect custody, never an orphan or unused-dependency finding. A typed settings map in a workspace manifest (allowBuilds and kin) carries only values of its declared type, sorted by key — a scaffold-hint placeholder parses as neither state and the package manager re-warns on every invocation. A dependency or capability admission — and equally an .api consolidation or move — moves its full touch-point set together: central manifest row, consuming project manifest reference, branch README registry row, folder README registry rows of every consumer, and owning .api tier — a member present without its counterparts is drift in either direction. A package registers in exactly one README section at its tier-correct cluster, substrate packages in the substrate cluster and domain packages in their domain cluster, so a second row in another cluster is a drift seed and a missing-registration claim is valid only after sweeping every section cluster, since the single-cluster sweep is the false-missing engine that manufactures the double; registration singularity is per-README, so a package lawfully registers at two sibling folders under a ruled role split the strata force apart and a cross-folder dedup demand against that split is false. An admitted package no planning page composes is an orphaned admission demanding the composing fence or the re-card, never silent retention. Folder-tier .api files split by one discriminant: a genuine DOMAIN slice documenting folder-specific capability beyond the substrate is the only legitimate folder-tier file — the subset of substrate members a folder uses is a scattered copy merging up into the substrate catalogue, a pure-redirect stub deletes on sight, and a substrate package shows at the folder through its README registry and project manifest, never a re-catalogue. A README package card row is the backticked package id plus at most one dash-led charter clause — a version pin, parenthetical, .api link, or multi-line depth is a defect. Folder README router entries resolve 1:1 to on-disk .planning pages, a page rename ripples its router row and ARCHITECTURE codemap node in the same diff, and every cross-folder seam edge appears on both endpoint ARCHITECTURE pages with mirrored glyph and identical [KIND] while an in-package relation stays in the codemap, never a seam.

Capability parity across sibling folders sharing a concept is a same-corpus hunt: when a touched page deepens a shared concept — a new classification axis, category, field family, enum member, or wire field landed on one folder's owner — its cross-folder counterpart pages realizing the same concept in their own owners are checked for that capability at their own grain, and a counterpart still composing the narrower surface is a capability gap. Every finding names the leading owner, the shared concept, and each lagging counterpart owner. Both directions: a fence narrower than its counterpart, and a README or ARCHITECTURE registry lagging landed capability. Never a mirror demand — each side keeps its own owners, vocabulary, and casing, and the gap is the missing capability, never missing identical text. Never-regress: a parity fix widens the lagging side; shrinking the leading side to match is the rejected resolution. The standing signal shapes: a seam edge whose two endpoint pages disagree on the carried fields, and a widened .api catalogue whose consumer pages still compose the narrow surface.

An .api catalogue presents only the library's live current surface. Findings demanding silent whole removal: a version field or version number anywhere (the central manifest owns versions); an obsolete, deprecated, or superseded member, overload, or import path kept beside or instead of its live replacement; replacement narration in any phrasing — 'use Y instead', 'replaced by', 'formerly', 'supersedes', 'in older versions', 'legacy'; a migration note, tombstone, or dead-form warning. The demanded fix catalogues the live replacement and deletes the dead form whole, never a caveat beside it. Legacy anchoring hides in many shapes — hunt the semantics, not the keyword list. A domain symbol genuinely named Version, Legacy, or Obsolete that IS the live current API is real surface, never flagged.

An .api catalogue's [04]-[IMPLEMENTATION_LAW] grades at operator depth both directions. Negative shapes demanding the member-level seam: a [STACKING] bullet naming only a package ('integrates with numpy', 'pairs well with X'); a seam lacking a concrete member on either end; a sibling cited without its catalogue path anchor; a missing within-library composition row; '(none)' where the language-substrate tier (libs/<lang>/.api/) carries an obvious composing sibling; a [RAIL_LAW] Reject row generic enough to paste unchanged between unrelated packages (the byte-copy defect) instead of naming the exact hand-rolled form THIS package forecloses; [TOPOLOGY] rows restating what a signature already shows instead of behavioral law it cannot. Positive bar worth naming as conformance: a [STACKING] bullet spelling this package's output flowing into the named sibling member with arguments ('to_builtins(struct, str_keys=True) feeding Span.set_attributes'), a canonical chained rail spanning sibling catalogues at member grain, and a Reject row naming the specific reimplementation the surface deletes. A widened stacking claim verifies against the named sibling catalogue — a seam citing a member the sibling catalogue does not carry is a phantom seam.

IDEAS and TASKLOG card markers match the file's own template comment: card status rides the closed vocabulary [ACTIVE]/[QUEUED]/[BLOCKED] open and [COMPLETE]/[DROPPED] closed — an invented token ([UPSTREAM-BLOCKED] and kin), a malformed leader, or an absolute path inside a card is a defect. Card and research IDs are semantic UPPERCASE_SNAKE slugs carrying meaning — a numeric id ([0007]-class), a compact-alphanumeric id ([T1]/[C1]/[R23]-class), and a hyphenated slug are defects alike. Open cards carry Capability, Shape, Unlocks, and Anchors, with Arms, Route, Tension, Ripple, and Atomic present only on their stated conditions; a closed row collapses to the one-line disposition, a DROPPED row carries its rejection reason at ruling grain so the drop cannot re-litigate, and bullets flattened into run-on dashes are a repairable deformation demanding restoration, never rewrite license. A card closes or re-anchors only on disk evidence, never a roster's say-so — a roster-vs-disk contradiction narrows the card and flags the contradiction. A design page carries the terminal [RESEARCH] section always — (none) marks empty, absence is an error — and the section is load-bearing recorded epistemic debt: a diff deleting, deforming, or orphaning its markers — a [TOKEN]-[OPEN|BLOCKED] row losing its exact question or verification route, a research marker severed from the fence it gates — is a defect, and a resolved row deletes whole with no tombstone. Every finding names the file, the marker, and the template clause it breaches.

RULINGS.md files are universal per-folder decision registries — standing at every registry-carrying tier: package folders, branch tiers, cross-libs, and the tests/ estate root and language trees, an unpopulated instance carrying (none)-marked sections — and their rows are settled law with the force of the owning page. Review runs both directions. Diffs against rulings: an edit re-litigating a settled ruling — re-admitting a rejected package, folding a ruled-plural surface, re-homing a ruled owner, re-adding a retired structure — fires with the ruling row cited verbatim, and the demanded fix routes as a card (an IDEA at concept grain or a TASK at landing grain), never an inline workaround. Rulings against disk: a RULINGS.md diff answers the admission bar — a row dies only when its fact AND its why both live at one durable surface, and a page stating the what while the discriminant, lost guarantee, or refuted objection stays homeless ADMITS the row; a fact-and-why-carried row is derivable creep demanding deletion; a row contradicting landed pages or manifests is drift; a ruling homed above the narrowest tier containing it, duplicated across tiers, or spelled outside the closed section vocabulary ([PACKAGES]/[SHAPE]/[COLLAPSE]/[STRUCTURE]/[PROCESS]) is a defect. Positive direction equally: a diff realizing a capability a ruling anticipated is conformance worth naming, a diff whose stronger form a ruling anticipates receives the ruling-aligned deeper demand — a fix landing below the ruled bar is unfinished — and a diff exposing a homeless discriminant — two lawful twin surfaces whose separating rule lives nowhere durable — earns the new ruling row at the narrowest owning tier.

Pinned-substrate composition defects worth hunting: a lifecycle-gate read guarding an effectful entrypoint evaluated at composition time instead of inside the deferred effect body; a bounded fixpoint iteration spelled as a Schedule instead of a Range.Fold; a zone-less foreign wall-clock stamp fabricated into a UTC Instant instead of NodaTime LocalDateTime/LocalDate; an Enum.IsDefined admission gate — the non-generic overload throws ArgumentException on a boxed probe whose type mismatches the enum's underlying type, and every unnamed [Flags] combination reports undefined, so admission rides Enum.ToObject or the generic overload plus a name round-trip; a host-subclass override of a concrete virtual carrying default rendering or behavior (OnDraw, OnPaint, and kin) missing the base call before its own advice, silently erasing the native visual; a Match whose Some arm null-probes a payload Option structurally cannot make null, or a from-in-Fin.Succ query shell binding a pure value no rail step consumes — Fin.Succ inside a query legally sequences an effect or captures a pre-mutation read; a hand-rolled Validation tower beside a generated Validate/ValidateFactoryArguments bridge — the generated bridge is the one admission authority; sibling surfaces re-spelling shared-rail lifecycle machinery where the gate owner's generic members belong — a params ReadOnlySpan staged harvest congruent by construction, a Fin Rollback extension owning failure-release custody, one context-guarded entry fold — never per-page re-mints or per-site MapFail-dispose blocks; a union carrying raw scalar payloads without one generated-Switch admission fold whose per-case guard arms bind once before dispatch; a selector family lacking the one guarded live-row projector a new case inherits refusal from; a mutation receipt comparing optional slot payloads through generated record equality where slot-owned content equality decides change; a mixed lifecycle-and-value guard not split by axis — the released/live leg refuses on InvalidContext, the value leg on InvalidInput; an UndoBracket.Begin outside DocumentCommit.Sealed re-minting the shared commit envelope Sealed owns; a needs-derivation seq re-spelled per site where the one derivation row owns it; a seam host read — census and count reads included — executing outside the catch frame that owns the crossing; a case or nested record sharing a host type's simple name leaving construction unqualified — the corpus type shadows the host spelling, so the whole collision family qualifies globally; exclusive disposable custody riding a copyable record — record copy and with re-mint disposal ownership, so shared custody is reference-counted or the owner non-copyable.

Pinned-substrate composition defects worth hunting: an Effect Layer minted by calling a factory twice where one shared const belongs — memoization is by reference identity, Layer.fresh the only sharing opt-out; a RequestResolver rebuilt per call site, re-minting identity and defeating the batch window; a Ref mutated inside map/tap where Stream.mapAccum/scan owns element state; a broker offset, log sequence, or other foreign 64-bit coordinate crossing through Number — precision silently lost, arithmetic riding BigInt over the provider native string spelling; a value beside a generated union without its Record<GeneratedUnion, V> annotation and (x satisfies never) residue proof.

Pinned-substrate composition defects worth hunting: an import-time side-effect plugin registry silently emptied by lazy import where importlib.metadata.entry_points owns discovery — the plugin set reads from distribution metadata, activated once through EntryPoint.load() and traversed fallibly; a single-door gated() binding any dependent module before arming process-global configuration (jax_enable_x64 and kin) — the pre-arm dependent bakes the un-armed default permanently, so the door imports the config owner alone, arms, then binds dependents; a functools.cache over a subprocess-backed helper left racing — the cache dedups the value, not the first construction, and a shared -stay_open pipe interleaves unserialized exchanges, so one narrow Lock brackets helper resolution and each whole exchange.

One fact owns one home across the .claude/ estate: a SKILL.md root re-teaching mechanism its own references/ or templates/ file owns, or one policy sentence spelled at teaching grain in two skill or agent files, is a fork that drifts on first edit. Flag on the diffed copy, name the owning file, and demand the copy collapse to a one-line pointer naming the owner — a routing row or reference-list entry naming the owner and its one consumed concern is the routing contract, never a fork. Example: a SKILL.md root re-printing the envelope key table its own references file already carries.

One technique lives in one tier of a skill bundle — reference fence, template slot, or example body. A function, handler name, or distinctive literal (an error number, a regex, a source string) resolving in more than one tier of one bundle is a cross-tier fork: flag every site and demand the one-tier home ruled by the technique's nature — mechanism to the reference, skeleton to the template, composition to the example. Duplication review compares content, never just detects the pair: the surviving copy is proven the strongest before a twin deletes — a copy that dropped a member, guard, or read its twin carries is the degraded copy, and the difference is part of the finding.

One decision spread (docgen SAME_DECISION_SPREAD) is a run of near-similar rules each restating most of one decision — across the sentences of one passage, the rows of one durable, or the files of one bundle or config, including two near-similar lines a diff introduces or leaves standing — distinct from a fact fork, which duplicates one fact. Demand the nuance-preserving restructure at the ruled owner: one higher-resolution ruling absorbing the run, smaller than its sources, every distinct decision surviving as its own clause — never a mega-entry concatenating the collapsed items, never a longer merged line, never brute deletion. A neighbor separating a different failure class or false-positive discriminator is distinct law, never a restatement — do not flag it. Example: three body rules each restating validate-before-return in different verbs collapse to the one gate contract; two guards whose discriminators split interior re-validation from host-crossing admission stay siblings.

Every references/, templates/, examples/, or scripts/ path a .claude/ file cites, and every skill or agent name a workflow or command invokes, resolves on disk in the same commit — a pointer whose target is absent or renamed promises capability no file materializes. The census runs both directions: every shipped artifact under a bundle's references/, templates/, examples/, and scripts/ is routed by its root, so an unrouted or dead-routed artifact is unreachable capability demanding the true route row. Flag the dangling path or unrouted artifact, name the citing or owning file, and demand the rename ripple every referrer — or the route row land — in the same diff. Example: a routing row (references/x.md) surviving after the file's rename to y.md, or a shipped template no root row reaches.

A skill or agent description carves an activation boundary no sibling claims; two descriptions matching one realistic phrasing with no explicit belongs-to-<other> delegation clause is a routing collision the harness resolves arbitrarily. Flag the changed description, name the colliding sibling, and demand the symmetric boundary pair — each description naming the other's deliverable as its refusal, repaired on both descriptions, never a body edit. Example: two skills both firing on 'review the code' with no local-versus-hosted split.

An agent definition's frontmatter carries name (lowercase-hyphen) and a description stating when to delegate; model stays inside sonnet|opus|fable|inherit or a full model id — a haiku grant breaches estate model law — and an omitted tools field legally inherits all while a declared tools roster is a designed surface granting only what the body's contract exercises. Flag the missing field, the out-of-enum value, or the unexercised declared grant by name. Example: an agent declaring model: haiku, or a declared tools roster granting Write to a read-only recon contract.

Every libs/ package is an independently adoptable library an unrelated application takes, so it assumes no consumer, no sibling set, no deployment shape, and no lifecycle owner. Deployment shape arrives as data on the Tier-0 axis roster (libs/.planning/ARCHITECTURE.md [10]-[CONSUMPTION_MODEL]) that the composition root supplies: a closed axis fixes its value vocabulary there while host and providers are open capability-descriptor rows their supplying branch fills, so a compile-time assumption of any axis value is a defect and enumerating an open axis's instances re-anchors the roster to the instance set that happens to exist. The assumed-consumer shapes are a package branching on which product hosts it, reading an ambient global, gating on a build flag, and assuming a sibling is present — sibling presence is itself an axis value bound as a declared port the composition root fills, and an unbound port is a refused capability, never a crash. Both failed responses are the defect: silent degradation and a narrowed public surface; the correct response is refusal at admission with typed evidence naming the axis, stated once at the package's admission owner rather than per entry.

The three language estates are peers: no branch is a producer above another, no branch is a prerequisite, and a single-language application resolves its own graph whole. Read the atomic case live from tests/contracts/manifest.json and apply tests/contracts/README.md before judging authority. A case contradicting its declared class, actors, readiness, proof, or asset custody is a finding. Entry grouping never changes those facts. A case whose actors all sit in one runtime belongs in that branch's proof tree. A fence or adapter requiring another branch to exist is the prerequisite defect. Never copy the authority roster here.

Transcription applies only where Tier-0 explicitly requires branch-local vocabulary, and a drifted row is repaired at every named anchor in the same change, never through a shared library or a peer import. Generated contract bindings are not transcriptions: they derive from the corpus proto authority, so a hand branch spelling beside them is a second wire model and deletes.

Append-only log planes own truth and every derived plane carries zero authority: folds, snapshots, traces, cell tables, overlays, and actor configurations accelerate reads and drop at warm-up cost. A shape crossing planes names its truth plane, its rebuild route, and the retention floor below which rebuild fails, so a crossing stating fewer than all three is a finding naming the page that owns the crossing. Reading a projection as authority is the defect it forecloses: a dropped accelerator becomes loss, and a write-back path into the derived plane folds drift into the log. An owner carrying no log declares itself ephemeral, so a durability or as-of claim on an unlogged owner is a finding whose repair is the missing declaration or the missing log.

A reviewer rule, check-run agent, gate, or durable page enumerating rows a live table owns transcribes what it must walk, and the tell is the table having grown past the enumeration. docs/laws/topology.md states the law directly — a consumer WALKS the coupling table and resolves each row live, never copies its contents — so the demanded fix names the table and derives the hunt from it, and the transcribed roster deletes whole rather than gaining the missing rows. This is self-applying: a strata roster copied into a dependency rule, a hardcoded subset of coupling classes inside a topology lens, and a language-named owner roster beside a live manifest are the standing instances. Row [01] of that table also obligates every reviewer config from a docs/stacks/ page, a docgen template, or a Tier-0 law edit — one config updated and two stale is the finding, named per stale config.

A fixed roster of styles, patterns, variants, or presets spelled as a closed member set is seed data pigeonholed into structure: an owner whose cases enumerate today's instances cannot admit tomorrow's, so demand the algebraic owner over named parameters with the roster demoted to rows it consumes. The same demand runs inverted — a knob set whose combinations the body re-derives collapses into policy rows, table dispatch, or a denser polymorphic owner with defaults derived once — and it runs on the open axes of a settled roster, where enumerating the instances that happen to exist re-anchors what the open form forecloses. A closed vocabulary a durable owner fixes is not this defect; the discriminant is whether the owner or the world decides the member set.

Terms the corpus reuses carry one binding sense minted at docs/glossary/, and every claim resolves that corpus live on the diff — a finding carrying a copy of a definition or a term roster reads stale the moment an entry lands. Two conditions fire: a spelling a glossary entry's [NOT] line names, and a glossary-defined term used against the sense its entry binds; both name the owning entry. A concept a durable page names with no glossary entry binding its sense, recurring across two or more surfaces, is the third finding and routes as the entry mint at the owning band, never as a page-local definition. Synonym choice among words no glossary entry defines is void — the house owns the voice, so a term finding cites the entry or dies.

In libs/csharp the kernel Deterministic is the branch's ONE splitmix64 owner. Hunt every fence for the gamma literal 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 or a transcribed splitmix64 mixer outside Rasm/Domain/identity, and for `new Random(` outside a `Deterministic.Source(...)` crossing — each is a draw fork splitting replay across runtimes; demand the `Deterministic.Source(seed, lanes)` adapter. Carve: a frozen wire constant whose VALUES define a format (the FastCDC Gear table at Rasm.Compute/Runtime/codecs) is a recorded split, never a fork — do not flag it.

One fault reason owns ONE recovery posture, declared at the family owner. Hunt fault families whose one reason is handled under divergent postures at different consumers — retried at one site, terminally refused at another — and demand the posture COLUMNS on the family row, never per-site divergence. Posture grades as a band, never a boolean: a stored retryable column beside the band is a second authority the projection off that band already answers, so a bare retry bit standing where the band belongs is the finding and the demanded fix names the band the branch fault ruling fixes. A producer-stated re-drive window rides the raised VALUE and re-seats the schedule base per refusal — a policy row holding a slot only a raise can fill is decorative density, and one shared word spanning the wire, band, and value altitudes claims a single authority where three answer.

Retriability on a TypeScript fault policy row is TWO columns, never one bit: recovery bands what a re-drive reaches (throttled, transient, terminal) and reoffer names the route the next offer takes (wait re-invokes identically, restart re-takes the dependency handle, rescope narrows the offer the caller re-authors), so the elected representative carries its band and its route whole and the route record closes over the column. `retryable` survives only as the derived projection `recovery !== "terminal"` — a stored retry column beside the band is the deleted form, and a raise supplying its own retryable field is that defect one rank down. A throttled refusal carries its stated window on the VALUE as an `Option<Duration>` re-seating the schedule base for that refusal alone, so a policy row holding that slot holds one only a raise can fill; the three altitudes stay three words — wire `retry_after`, class band `throttled`, value `after` — and one shared spelling across them is the finding. Each policy row states its own detail text — a free-string `detail` field on the raise re-opens the axis `reason` already closed. Accumulating admission mints ONE census carrier off the same reason roster, its dominant issue electing on the rank lattice — a second `{ issues, class, message }` declaration forks one taxonomy into two.

A bounded iteration whose exhaustion arm returns the success rail certifies an unconverged state as converged. Hunt the mechanical shape: a for (pass < budget) loop or bounded fold whose fall-through returns success — especially where sibling budgets on the same page fault on exhaustion. Demand the typed exhaustion fault on budget fall-through; this is distinct from an unbounded-loop finding, and the success-shaped fall-through is the defect even when every iteration is individually correct.
